description: This PHP source file defines the Upgrade9 class within the Opencart installation's upgrade controller namespace. The class extends a core Controller class and contains an index method that performs database operations to insert or update specific records related to upgrade tasks during a version upgrade process. The method also handles error catching and prepares a JSON response with subsequent upgrade step information.

classes.name: Upgrade9
classes.description: A controller class responsible for performing upgrade step 9 during the OpenCart installation process. It inserts specific records into the database related to various system components such as banners, countries, currencies, and reports, and manages progression to the next upgrade step.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Performs database inserts/updates for multiple system components related to upgrade step 9, handles exceptions, and prepares JSON response with status, error messages, and link to the next upgrade step.
